claim_ceiling: Architecture and software-interface contracts only; no physical component interoperability, safety compliance or hardware commonality is claimed.

shared_interface_contracts.qualification_boundary: Configuration and identity semantics only; does not validate installed hardware.
Connector, voltage, network, redundancy, timing and environmental rating remain class-specific.
Isolation devices, insulation design, creepage/clearance, current interruption, service procedures and safety integrity are class-specific and require qualification.
Pack structure, chemistry, thermal paths, voltage class, current limits, cell monitoring and crash/impact protection are class-specific.
Physical connector, protocol version, inlet/receiver, cable cooling, charge curve, contactor sequencing and interoperability are not assumed interchangeable.
Thermal topology, coolant, heat exchangers, thermal runaway/fire controls and validated limits remain specific to each vehicle and component.
Motor topology, gear reduction, torque map, inverter, brakes, axle, traction-control and regenerative-braking behavior remain vehicle-specific.
PTO, hydraulics, hoists, ramps/lifts, refrigeration, implement attachments and their load paths/interlocks require class-specific engineering.
Grid studies, protection, charger sizing, queueing and operating policies need the actual site and fleet.
Privacy, access control, regulated records, supplier serialization and certified maintenance rules depend on deployment and jurisdiction.
Actual safe state, hazard controls, recovery points, towing/lifting, braking and autonomy behaviors require vehicle-specific hazard analysis and testing.

platform_families.label: Cargo micro-mobility
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: No cross-family physical hardware reuse assumed.
specialization_constraints: Loaded handling, braking, stability, rider exposure, wheel/frame ratings and human-assist controls are specific to this class.

platform_families.label: Compact and family passenger road vehicles
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Candidate reuse only after mass, crash structure, axle, thermal, voltage and packaging validation; no shared pack/frame is assumed.
specialization_constraints: Occupant protection, airbag/restraint integration, intrusion/retention, child-seat and cargo packaging, axle/tire loads and HVAC duty require each-variant validation.

platform_families.label: Accessible shuttle and city bus
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Reuse interface semantics and test protocols only unless a qualified chassis/body programme proves compatibility.
specialization_constraints: Boarding/ramp/lift/securement, passenger capacity, body structure, egress, door/HVAC duty, route dwell and accessible service recovery are specific to each vehicle.

platform_families.label: Light commercial van, rural utility and emergency response
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Share diagnostics and energy/service interfaces. No common chassis or battery module is assumed across road, off-road and emergency bodies.
specialization_constraints: Cargo retention, water/dust/corrosion, recovery hardware and rescue-body requirements differ. Emergency export power requires a separately qualified isolated power system and reserve policy.

platform_families.label: Municipal work truck and urban distribution truck
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Candidate common rolling-chassis modules only after gross/axle/body/load-path and crash validation; body and work interfaces remain configuration-specific.
specialization_constraints: Municipal equipment simultaneous peaks and work-tool duty differ from delivery payload and stop-start routes. Account for axle loads, centers of gravity and work-body interlocks.

platform_families.label: Smallholder and row-crop agricultural machines
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Share implement-power semantics, diagnostics and work-cycle measurement only. No shared tractor chassis, axle, pack or PTO sizing is presumed.
specialization_constraints: Implement geometry, drawbar/PTO/hydraulic loads, soil/traction, ballast, rollover protection, seasonal availability and local repair conditions must be assessed per class and tool.

platform_families.label: Compact construction excavator
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Share energy accounting and diagnostics contracts only; excavation hydraulics, stability, arm geometry and tool interlocks remain machine-specific.
specialization_constraints: Hydraulic duty, load charts, emergency lowering, lifting stability, track/undercarriage, cooling at low travel speed and electrical/hydraulic lockout require dedicated validation.

platform_families.label: Long-haul and port/yard heavy vehicles
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Share charge planning, energy accounting and service telemetry. No shared axle, frame, charger intake or pack fit is assumed.
specialization_constraints: Highway endurance/grade/retarder duty differs from low-speed high-torque hitch cycles, short dwell and yard interactions. Heavy-duty charge interface compatibility must be qualified end-to-end.

platform_families.label: Underground mobile unit and open-pit haul variants
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Share the model boundary, telemetry and energy interfaces only. Mine-qualified components, haul chassis, trolley collector, voltage class and fire response are site/class-specific.
specialization_constraints: Underground ventilation/egress/water/dust needs differ from open-pit gross mass, haul-road grade, tire limits, trolley corridor coverage and fault recovery. Direct-supply energy must not be double-counted as battery energy.

platform_families.label: Warehouse and yard autonomous carrier
platform_families.hardware_reuse_policy: Reuse scheduling, telemetry and charge-state contracts; perception, braking, protective fields, load geometry and safe-stop architecture are specific.
specialization_constraints: Human-sharing assumptions, safe stop, localization/network failure behavior, charger docking, recovery and fleet-level blocked-route logic must be validated for the intended facility.
